about.text: Colombia's and Venezuela's dulce de leche, simmered from milk and sugar until it is thick and caramel brown.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Arequipe is the Colombian and Venezuelan name for dulce de leche in its fluid, brown form. In Colombia it grew out of the colonial manjar blanco into a creamier, caramel-coloured product; Buga is noted for artisanal production.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: add bicarbonate
steps.note: A pinch neutralises lactic acid so the milk does not curdle while it is concentrated, and promotes browning.
Finished in an open pan, industrially to about 68 °Brix.
